# Banneton

A banneton is a ridged basket, woven from cane or lined with linen, in which
a shaped loaf takes its final proof. The ridges press a pattern of fine flour
lines into the dough and, more importantly, the basket holds a soft
high-hydration dough in shape so it rises upward instead of spreading flat.

## Why it matters

- Holds a loose dough in shape through a long, cool overnight proof.
- Wicks a little moisture from the dough's surface, so it releases cleanly.
